_comment: A stored Mail Alerts row and the explanation the backend gives for it. tests/test_booking_block_reasons.py holds services/booking_block_reasons.py to booking_block; MailMonitoringNotifications.test.jsx renders it.

row.booking_block_reason: Interview round could not be identified
row.recommended_action: Multiple active interview slots match this candidate; the source email does not identify one safely.

booking_block.title: Booking not cancelled
booking_block.reason: This email cancels an interview, but the candidate has more than one booking it could refer to, so nothing was cancelled.
booking_block.action: Open the candidate in Daily Ops and cancel the right booking by hand.
